Birthday Countdown

Enter your birthday for a live countdown to your next one — days, hours, minutes and seconds — plus the age you'll turn and a fun message.

Your date of birth never leaves your browser — the countdown runs entirely on your device.

📖 How to use

  1. Enter your date of birth using the date picker.
  2. The tool instantly works out when your next birthday falls.
  3. Watch the live countdown tick down in days, hours, minutes and seconds.
  4. See the age you'll turn, plus a fun message based on how close the big day is.

❓ Frequently asked questions

What if my birthday is today?

Then the countdown shows zero and you'll get a happy birthday message along with your new age.

How are leap-day (Feb 29) birthdays handled?

In non-leap years the countdown targets February 28, and a note explains the adjustment.

Is my birth date stored anywhere?

No. Everything runs in your browser — your date of birth is never sent to any server.
